title: MEV/price-gap capture SIMULATION — real on-chain quotes, zero trades

gate.label: gated OFF
gate.note: detection-only — nothing executable; the live arm is Mr. Esters' alone (mirror of WARP_LIVE_SEND)

feePolicy.note: capture value = gross round trip − pool fees (netted in quotes) − gas; the 0.5%/capped-$250 fee-model-v2 charge applies to user journeys, not internal capture legs (configurable)

method.evm: QuoterV2/PCS-QuoterV2 eth_call (read-only) USDC↔USDT @ 2,500 USDC; fee tiers 100+500 per chain; LiFi aggregator quote (fee=0) when reachable
method.sol: Orca whirlpool + Raydium CLMM pool-state walks (getAccountInfo) + pure leg quote math; Jupiter aggregator quote when reachable; SOL→USDC @ 5 SOL
method.gas: EVM: 2 txs × quoter gasEstimate × live eth_gasPrice → USDC via REAL same-chain WETH/WBNB→USDC quoter reads. Solana: 2 × 5000 lamports.
honesty: legs quoted sequentially (two read-only calls) — a real capture executes buy+sell atomically; net figures assume the quotes held
pool fees are netted inside the quotes (not double counted)
quotes are market data — they move; fixtures are dated

summary.note: gapBps = best-vs-second venue spread on the buy side (raw units). netRoundTripBps is net of BOTH pool fees (already inside the quotes) + gas. wouldCapture is the strict positive-net flag; see economic.* for the honest bar.
